title: Jester on Haunted Pier
description: A blue and purple jester kneels on a wooden pier, one hand reaching toward a glowing green star while the other touches the ground. White ghostly hands rise from the planks around him as four shadowy top-hatted figures stand behind him on the dock.
prompt: A mystical jester in ornate blue and purple costume with glowing blue orbs kneels dramatically on an old wooden pier at dusk, reaching with one hand toward a bright green glowing star floating above while white ghostly hands emerge from the wooden planks, four dark shadowy figures in top hats and Victorian coats stand behind him, blood-red cracked moon with prison bars in the sky, distant haunted city and bridge, lightning and dramatic clouds, cinematic fantasy style
